subject.title: Restore Cursor diagnostics and OpenCode workspace parity

question: Should CodexBar adopt both Cursor diagnostic-cost presentation and OpenCode multi-workspace switching as supported product surfaces, and should they land together or separately?
rationale: These are substantial new persisted settings and user-facing menu/widget modes, but no maintainer discussion confirms that the combined custom parity scope should be carried into the current v0.42 architecture.

options.title: Sponsor two focused ports
options.body: Port Cursor diagnostics and OpenCode workspace switching as separate current-main changes with independent upgrade tests and native proof.

options.title: Sponsor one combined port
options.body: Keep the combined parity goal but require a clean current-main replay and full cross-surface validation before merge.

options.title: Decline the new surfaces
options.body: Leave current main unchanged and close the stale branch after documenting that these custom parity features are not planned.

recommendation.title: Sponsor two focused ports
recommendation.body: Port Cursor diagnostics and OpenCode workspace switching as separate current-main changes with independent upgrade tests and native proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame, the v0.42 release re-root, and nearby OpenCode history make this account the best available owner for the scope decision.
